name: Bloom & Bean
headline: Your cosy corner for really good coffee.
subhead: Locally roasted beans, fresh-baked pastries, and a warm spot to slow down. Order ahead and skip the queue.

services.name: Coffee
services.text: Single-origin espresso, pour-over, and the flat white people cross town for.

services.name: Pastries
services.text: Croissants, danishes and scones, out of the oven before you're awake.

services.name: Lunch
services.text: Sandwiches and soups made each morning with what's good that week.

services.name: Whole cakes
services.text: Order a day ahead for birthdays and celebrations.

aboutText: Two friends, one small roaster, and a stubborn belief that a café should feel like someone's front room. We know most of our regulars by name and their order by heart.
reasons: Oat, almond and soy at no extra charge
